title: $1,000 IN CRYPTO
subtitle: SINCE 2018
outro:
Follow for the money
nobody explains.
vo: Back in twenty eighteen, everyone was arguing about crypto. Say you ignored the noise and put one thousand dollars into each. Bitcoin would have grown it to around thirteen thousand. Ethereum, twenty five thousand. But the quiet winner nobody talks about? BNB, which turned that thousand dollars into well over a hundred thousand. While Solana came from nowhere to shock everyone. The gap between these coins is staggering. Which did you hold? Follow, for the money nobody explains.
